title: Representing bijection and naturality of the extended actual counit
statement: Fix a prime l and a field k of positive prime characteristic different from l. Let X,Y be separated finite-type quasi-compact k-schemes, f:X to Y a k-morphism, and c a compactification. All coefficient fields are the canonical universe lift of Q_l and its fixed algebraic closure. Given Context P, realization Data D, and its support comparison A, every admissible Datum d with SystemIdentification s has a raw condensed counit t:F_Omega U_X(M) to U_Y(L). For every condensed bounded constructible Z on X, the map a to F_Omega(a) followed by t is bijective. For every actual supplied Brown-compatible map a:d.tower to e.tower over b:d.L to e.L, the raw counits satisfy F_Omega(U_X(LimitMap a)) followed by t_e = t_d followed by U_Y(b). All objects, counits and compatibility predicates are exactly those of [def-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction-data]; invertibility of an adjunction transpose is not assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Normalize the supplied strict-system coordinates. Pasting the normalized proper/open presentation mates identifies the recorded support comparison with the canonical beta. Transport the integral reconstructed Hom bijection through these equivalences. Naturality of the actual reduction/limit counit identifies its trace with Datum.integralCounit and gives its data-map square.

Localize the integral-linear Hom equivalence. At each finite coefficient extension transpose the scalar-extended trace to obtain the Brown comparison and its representing bijections, also for ramified extensions. Their defining counit equations give compatibility with further coefficient extension.

Apply filtered condensed representing-pair descent. Its scalar-extended trace equals the stated Datum.condensedCounit after using the bounded inclusion comparison and specified projection mate. Its bijectivity is exactly the first claim. Scalar-extension functoriality and projection naturality carry the integral trace square to the second claim.

theorem condensed_exceptional_counit_representation :
    (∀ (d : Datum l k P) (hd : d.Admissible l k)
      (s : SystemIdentification l k d hd) (Z : Omega l X.scheme),
      Function.Bijective (fun a : Z ⟶ (realization l k D X).obj
          (d.integral l k hd.reconstructs) ↦
        (CondensedRing.boundedConstructibleLowerShriekOfCompactification
          (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) l (f := X.map Y f) c).map a ≫
            d.condensedCounit l k D hd.reconstructs A s.reduction s.theta
              s.originUnit s.originSupport)) ∧
    (∀ (d e : Datum l k P) (hd : d.Admissible l k) (he : e.Admissible l k)
      (sd : SystemIdentification l k d hd) (se : SystemIdentification l k e he)
      (b : d.L ⟶ e.L) (a : d.tower ⟶ e.tower),
      d.SystemMap l k b a sd.theta se.theta →
      (CondensedRing.boundedConstructibleLowerShriekOfCompactification
        (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) l (f := X.map Y f) c).map
          ((realization l k D X).map (Datum.LimitMap l k a hd.reconstructs he.reconstructs)) ≫
        e.condensedCounit l k D he.reconstructs A se.reduction se.theta
          se.originUnit se.originSupport =
      d.condensedCounit l k D hd.reconstructs A sd.reduction sd.theta
          sd.originUnit sd.originSupport ≫ (realization l k D Y).map b)
